The [[Draconic Scythe (unique)|Draconic Scythe]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[scythe]] traded by [[Adept of Scythes]], a [[collector]] in the [[Divine Path]].

==Stats==
:[[Slashing damage]]: 9-41 (Requires 9 [[Scythe Mastery]]) 
:[[Damage]] +15% (while [[Health]] is above 50%) 
:[[Armor penetration]] +20% (Chance: 20%)
:[[Health]] +30
:Two-handed

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the non-unique [[Draconic Scythe]].

==Replica==
Except for the visual appearance, it is possible to create an exact technical replica for this item with:
*One of the following [[Scythe]]s:
**[[Briarwood Scythe]] from collectors [[Fopp]] or [[Pathfinder Mia]] 
**[[Elegant Scythe]] from collectors [[Pathfinder Alon]] or [[Blonk]]
**[[Hooked Scythe]] from collectors [[Klakki the Squire]] or [[Kaplack]]
**[[Suntouched Scythe]] from collectors [[Chinwe]] or [[Roland le Moisson]] or crafters [[Hahbe]], [[Kol Swordshanks]], [[Asiri]] or [[Aksah]]
**[[Destroyer Scythe]] from crafter [[Balthor Coalforge]]
**[[Imperial Scythe]] from collector [[Shen Xi]]
**[[Tormented Scythe]] from collector [[Deacon of Whispers]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Sundering]] [[Scythe Snathe]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Scythe Grip]] [[of Fortitude]]
OR
*One of the following [[Scythe]]s:
**[[Suntouched Scythe]] from collectors [[Hlengiwe]] or [[Hermehinu]] or crafters [[Asa]], [[Bolereh]], [[Derrick]], [[Hadusi]], [[Rahmdah]], [[Sende]], [[Shausha]], [[Soros]], or [[Tehshan]]
**[[Asuran Scythe]] from crafter [[Nojj]]
**[[Balthazar's Scythe]] from collector [[Zaishen Martial Weapon Master]]
**[[Deldrimor Scythe]] from crafter [[Grand Mason Stonecleaver]]
**[[Envoy Scythe]] from crafter [[Jessie Llam]]
**[[Norn Scythe]] from crafter [[Keti]]
**[[Oppressor's Scythe]] from collector [[Lionguard (collector)|Lionguard]]
**[[Raven Scythe]] from crafter [[Hulen Hairyback]]

**[[Charr Scythe]] from collector [[Tuomas]] (requires [[Bonus Mission Pack]])

==Unique counterparts==
[[Hand of the Forgotten]] and [[Arachni's Scythe]] have stats identical to this item.

==Trivia==
*This weapon is based on one of the winning designs by ''Lily'' from the [[Design-a-Weapon (2007)|Design-a-Weapon Contest]] held in 2007.
*The positioning for both the male and female versions of this scythe are angled incorrectly.
